name: Online Retail II
description: All transactions of a UK-based, registered, non-store online retailer (mainly unique all-occasion giftware, many wholesale customers) between 01/12/2009 and 09/12/2011.
citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D
keywords: NONE given on the UCI page (only subject area 'Business' and tasks Classification, Regression, Clustering)
variableMeasured_as_documented_by_UCI: InvoiceNo - 6-digit number, starts with 'c' for cancellations
UnitPrice - price per unit in sterling (GBP)
knownGaps_found_by_us: documentation does not match the file: the file says Invoice, Price, Customer ID (not InvoiceNo, UnitPrice, CustomerID)
documented '5-digit StockCode' - file also has 85123A, POST, DOT, M, BANK CHARGES ...
documented '6-digit invoice' - 6 invoices start with A (bad-debt adjustments)
documented lower-case 'c' - the file uses upper-case C
the two sheets overlap: December 2010 (23,221 identical lines) is in both, not documented
unit (GBP) only in the web text, not in the file; country names not standard (EIRE, RSA, USA, 'Unspecified')
no keywords, no data dictionary file, no provenance of how the export was made
